content: Melchizedek mu priest biya
Melchizedek ewerta nu Salem wonong ko king, se Kaem Kalel Biya ko priest tala.
Nu Abraham king saki kager te nunga moawaram ale pilawaram se marak tuam.

Se Abraham kager ningi melmasak suen la giam umu motam 10 ko pakakuram ale motam suanta mu nu tuam. Mel gira, noko nup umu ko nunguning mu “munan ningo diram la betera ko king”; ale betela, nu “Salem ko king”, ko nunguning mu, “Marolila ko King.”
Nu kumik nuam agi nuet nongotak mena se, nu kumik duap mena se kopa mena. Nu Kaem ko Namar iwita tala se priest ko tom pempem la bagoso.
Ikialko, nu kari biya nunguningkiri: Ana nanga girigir aora Abraham, nu kari nup biya tala, bare nu ko melmasak pakakumura motam 10 se motam suan gira mu nu tuam!

Law ko munan te mu, Levi ko gue te ko kari mu la diram priest ko aratasan, ale nongota nunga gue suan Abraham ko gue te mu nunga melmasak motam 10 ko pakakumusan mu ko motam suan gira mu nongote gisan.
Bare kari Melchizedek imi mu Levi ko gue te me tairam, bare nu Abraham, kari nup ago Kaem ilak den kaolam wore kote ko melmasak motam 10 se motam suan gira mu giam ale marak tuam.
Se mu paguwukam mena, kari nup kualala mu kari nup aliti mu marak tuso, mu ana uwuta ko ikisan.

Se priest alo Levi ko gue te melmasak motam suan gira mu gisan mu, nuna ali ewere ko kari ta se aking kua paranga namasan. Bare kari Melchizedek melmasak motam suan gira mu giam mu, batoga ko baluwoso mu, nu kumik kuera mateng mena, nu tom pempem la butata marak baga lagoso.
Se awiriya bo am iwita balukko tala: Levi ko gue mu kariimet nongote melmasak motam suan gira mu gisan, bare nuna mu betela nunga melmasak motam suan gira mu Abraham kuting te Melchizedek tuam.
Mu awuk, Melchizedek lage te Abraham arigam, tom umu te mu Levi me bilangakaso, bare noko girigir Abraham mu ta nu koma tata munan beteram.
Jesus Melchizedek ilak arerem

Girakala law kariimet taman umu ko munan te mu, Levi ko gue te la priest ura umu bita sapakasan. Se nunga ura umu kariimet nunga anu nungurukaso se dirma sapakasan le mu, anape ko akingtala Aaron ko gue te mena, bare Melchizedek molak kaora priest bo tala tairukko?
Se priest iru mu gue kigilik te tairam ale ko taira umu te Levi ko gue te la priest bagamonko law umu gurugam se geragam agi mu, law mu karogo tala lilim la geragukko.
Se kakirip ana ko baluwasan umu kari gue bo kigilik te tairam. Se kari gue nu te tairam mu bo ta altar te ura priest katir me ta bita arigam, mena biya.
Mu awuk, ana ikisan, anananga Kari Biya mu Judah ko gue te ko kari, se Moses kari gue umu priest ura betemonko katir me balu arigam, mena.
Se priest iru mu Melchizedek molak te am nu iwitatala aratam mu te ana wetang te ikisan tala, law mu lilim la geragam.
Se kakirip aitak priest ko aratam mu, law noko kari gue ko munan baluwoso mu me kaoram, mena. Mu nu marak ningo pempem anise lagarukko wore ko sokel aora noko ningi wore ko munan kaoram ale aratam.
Mu awuk, batoga bo noko ko iwita balam:

content.text: “Ni Melchizedek molak te priest ko baga se lagerko,” mam.

content: Bore te se, munan gira mu aitak menawuman ale guruguman, mu awuk, munan umu sokel mena se nanga sangukko me terong.
Mu awuk, law ko munan mu daiga bagara ko munan saongam se me ta dirma saparam, mena. Bare loagara iru aitak taman imi mu, nanga tagi Kaem kumik duap te nanga awuram.
Se loagara iru umu Kaem kota numi nup te den balu se priest iru ko atumukiram. Bare priest saki aratukasan, mu nu munan uwuta te ura priest umu me nungaram, mena.
Bare loagara iru imi priest ko atumukira se mu, Kaem kota numi nup te iwita maonam:

content.text: “Kari Biya kota numi nup te sokel ago
noko ko balam, ale noko ikia balam imi me gurugokko:
‘Ni mu pempem la priest ko baga se lagerko.’ ”

content: Nu kota numi nup te sokel ago la balam umu kaora, Jesus kontrak iru ningo nunguningkiri mu ko priest supuling ko bagoso.
Girakala priest alo mu suen biya priest ura ko aratukasan, mu awuk, saki kuakasan se saki iru nuguwim te aratukasan.
Bare Jesus mu kumik kuera mateng mena, pempem la baga lagoso, owore te se, noko priest ura umu nu kota kumik te la ani lagoso.
Bore te se, nu kota mu awiriya nu nup te Kaem kote tairukko mu sangaru saparukko terong. Mu awuk, nu pempem la nuna nongoma taso ale Kaem ilak wosenga kira lagoso.

Buta se priest supuling uwuta, kumik memek bo mena, nu ali kari memek nunga iwita mena, nu laili biya, nu kualala ko melmasak umu suen la nunga kia saparam ale kualala biya bagoso, umutang anananga sangukko umu asele terong nunguningkiri.

Nu priest supuling saki alo nunga iwita, kota ko memek ko pempem la tama bita se, kariimet nunga memek ko Kaem tama bita tuokko iwita mena. Nu tom suanta ko, kariimet nunga memek ko numi memek te Kaem tama bita tui kam beteram, ale udagi tama betera munan bo uwuta me bita se lagarukko, mena, mu suanta uwutata.

Mu awuk, law ko munan te kari priest supuling ko nunga balso mu ali ewere ko kari yam, se nosokel mena. Bare Kaem kota numi nup te den sokel ago udagi balam mu, kota ko Namar priest supuling ko bagarukko balam. Se ko Namar umutang priest nunguningkiri, tom suen la ura umu bitirukko baga se lagoso.

footnotes.text: Melchizedek: Genesis 14:17-20; Psalm 110:4. Hebrew den te “melech” ­ king, “zedek” ­ munan diram, se “salem” ­ marolila. Munan suen la Melchizedek kumik te arik mu Jesus kumik te karogo la arikko.
Jacob namar Levi ko gue te priest supuling Aaron aratam. Nu Moses ko laun.
John 14:6, Romans 8:3-4, se Galatians 2:16 ago arikko.
Jesus nangama taso ale Kaem ilak wosenga kira lagoso: Romans 8:34; Hebrews 4:14-16; 1 John 2:1.
